content: Hamlet is a renowned brand of cigars manufactured by Benson and Hedges. These cigars are available in various forms, including miniature versions as well as standard-length cigars. They are frequently marketed as mild cigars in their promotional campaigns. The Hamlet brand was initially introduced in the United Kingdom in 1964. In more recent years, the brand has expanded its presence to several markets across Western Europe. Hamlet cigars are particularly well-known in the UK for their humorous advertisements, which were directed by Paul de Freitas. These commercials typically depict an individual in an unfortunate or awkward situation, who then lights a Hamlet cigar and experiences a temporary sense of relief or solace. The advertisements are accompanied by the iconic musical piece Air on a G String by Johann Sebastian Bach. However, following the implementation of restrictions on tobacco advertising in the UK and much of Europe, these commercials are no longer broadcast.
